blurb: Guests board at the Pier at Winnipesaukee in Weirs Beach for public or private tiki boat cruises. Cruises are BYOB and guests can bring their own food or purchase snacks and drinks at the pier store. Boats have bathrooms and life jackets are provided for all passengers.
